newsitem.title: USA: Dow tops 6500, aided by Morris as banks shrs rally.
newsitem.headline: Dow tops 6500, aided by Morris as banks shrs rally.

text.p: The Dow industrials breezed past the 6500 level for the first time in history as bank stocks rallied and Philip Morris surged late on news that FDA Commissioner David Kessler will leave his post.

"People are moving out of technology stocks and into banks. Banks are red hot," said Stephen Shobin, a technical analyst at Lehman Brothers. Several bank stocks hit year highs after positive analyst comments and as the bond yield fell.
The Dow climbed 76 points or 1.17 percent to about 6548, its biggest point rise since August 2's 85.08-point rise.
